root_cause.text: In `rxgxk_verify_response()`, the length check uses `xdr_round_up(token_len)` which can overflow when `token_len` is near the maximum 32-bit value, producing a small result that bypasses the check, allowing an oversized token to be processed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (token_len > len || ...)` before the rounding check. The commit message states: "integer overflow due to rounding up token_len before checking it, thereby allowing the length check to be bypassed."

candidates.rationale: Reads attacker-controlled token_len from network without validation; large values lead to integer overflow in subsequent rounding operation.
The expression xdr_round_up(token_len) overflows when token_len is near UINT_MAX, causing the check to pass despite an oversized token.
Variable initialization; not directly vulnerable but part of the same code path handling token data.
Jump target when check fails; overflow in the condition bypasses this safety exit, allowing further processing of malformed data.
Trace statement that uses the unchecked token_len; although not directly causing overflow, it reflects the vulnerable value in debugging output.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement performs the length check using xdr_round_up(token_len) which can overflow when token_len is near UINT_MAX, causing the check to incorrectly pass and allowing an oversized token to be processed.
This statement reads the attacker-controlled token_len from the network without validation, providing the value that later triggers the integer overflow in xdr_round_up().
This statement is the safety exit when the length check fails. Due to the overflow bypass, this goto is not executed, allowing further processing of malformed data.
This statement initializes token_offset; while not directly vulnerable, it is part of the same code path that handles token data and is executed even when the check is bypassed.
This trace statement uses the unchecked token_len, reflecting the vulnerable value in debugging output and indicating that token_len has not been properly validated.
